Sales Information - Samancor Chrome
![](https://samancorcr.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/WCM-2018-stock-41-1920x1280.jpg) # Sales Information # Pricing & Ordering Information ##### What product does Samancor Chrome produce and sell? Samancor Chrome produces high carbon ferrochrome (charge chrome). We also sell chrome ore. ##### How can orders be made for these products? Please note, no orders or information requests will be processed telephonically. Please make your enquiry by email to the marketing department. Address your email to Marketing, email: [**Sales@SamancorCr.com**](mailto:Sales@SamancorCr.com). ##### What information should I include in my email? In your initial email, please include the following information: * A short description of your company * Details of your location * The product you require including chemical specification * The tonnage required * An estimated delivery date ##### How long will it take to receive a response? The marketer will respond to your email within five working days. ##### Procurement Centre * [Corporate Governance](https://samancorcr.com/corporate-governance/) * [Legal Information](https://samancorcr.com/corporate-governance/legal-information/) * [Sales Information](https://samancorcr.com/corporate-governance/sales-information/) * [SHEQ Information](https://samancorcr.com/corporate-governance/sheq-information/) * [Procurement Information](https://samancorcr.com/corporate-governance/procurement-services/) [CAREERS](https://samancorcr.com/careers/)
